nodes.question: What are the practical challenges for marine reserves to be successfully implemented?
nodes.answer: The practical challenges include the large distances that many species move as adults or larvae, which can conflict with the spatial boundaries of the reserves, and the need for sustainable financing to support staffing and enforcement, particularly in low-capacity countries.
nodes.paragraph: 2023). Yet practical challenges exist for marine reserves to be successfully implemented. Many species move over large distances as adults or lar - vae, which can be at odds with the spatial boundaries of a reserve (Cowen and Sponaugle 2009 ; Song et al. 2017 ). Furthermore, reserves that produce measurable outcomes require sustainable financing to support staffing and enforce- ment, which can be challenging for low-capacity countries (Grorud-Colvert et al. 2021; Millage et al. 2021). This paper addresses the class of fish stocks that are transboundary those that distribute across two or more exclusive economic zones (EEZs) through adult move- ment or larval dispersal.
